headline: Profit up from a year ago but far below last quarter
summary_short: ENEOS revenue was ¥3,364.7B, up 19.2% y/y, with operating income of ¥193.6B, up 90.1% y/y but down 56.7% q/q.
summary_long: Net income of ¥96.9B rose 22.3% y/y but fell 76.6% from ¥415.0B in the prior quarter. EPS was ¥37.09 versus ¥154.64 last quarter and ¥29.47 a year ago. Revenue was down 1.3% q/q.
